description: Create a NEW Google Ads campaign with its own dedicated budget. Handles the full create correctly: makes a non-shared CampaignBudget first, then the campaign referencing it, with network settings (Search Partners OFF, Display Expansion OFF) and MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS bidding. Defaults to PAUSED so you review before it serves. Refs #5739.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

name.description: Campaign name (also used for the budget name).

status.description: ENABLED to serve immediately (after ad review), PAUSED to review first. Default PAUSED.

name: gads_create_campaign
